title: An adopted site repository can gate changes on an HTTP golden master of its rendered pages
body:
Why: research 1114g (.krn/runs/market/research-1114g.md section 4) ranks an HTTP golden master as the strongest characterization gate for testless WordPress/PHP site repos: it protects untouched behaviour that no unit test covers.
Outcome: an adopted site repository can enable a golden-master gate: crawl its sitemap against a fixed database fixture (wp db export/import), normalise nonces, timestamps and asset hashes, store the HTML under the repo, and the gate fails on any diff not declared by the task.
Proof: on a sample WordPress repo the gate is green on a no-op change and red on a deliberate template edit, captured verbatim (KRN-12).
